description: Build a custom front-panel renderer for a piece of gear (amp, pedal, compressor, fuzz, preamp, power amp…) in Capture Finder from a front-on product photo and its captures' control list. Use when the user sends a gear image (and optionally controls) and wants a custom panel (definition in data/custom-amps.json, a Preact panel component + CSS in src/ui/panels/<name>/, artboard, verification, report).
